groups.notes: Ten eligible units; all started at ladder index 0, the only starting step this repository has measured. Recommendation retained at claude:claude-sonnet-5/low with low confidence because evidence remains single-armed. Three units were accepted without a material fix/re-review; seven required one or more. #111 is correctly counted as material re-review: one Standards finding, one Spec finding, and two fix passes (unit fix plus root test-evidence remediation). Its implementation started and finished at Sonnet 5/low. Two planner API-529 failures, one reviewer sandbox failure, the nested-PTY row, and the root-remediation Codex attempts all carry capabilityFailure:false or are environment/integration evidence, so none support a route floor increase. #111 reports null usage, cost, token, and duration values; it is included in sample counts but excluded from dollar medians, which retain nine cost-reporting units. No capability failure exists and no comparable unit started at a stronger step, so neither the two-unit capability ground nor a 25%-cheaper stronger-step comparison can be established. Index 0 cannot be lowered and no lower boundary probe exists. Cost remains confounded by change/context size and attempt count; do not compare this median across groups without normalization.

groups.notes: Four eligible units; all started at ladder index 0. Recommendation retained at claude:claude-sonnet-5/low with low confidence because no comparable unit started at a stronger step. Corrected #113 from clean-at-low to material re-review: its final unit route was claude:claude-sonnet-5/medium (ladder index 1), after low-effort work and review-driven correction; root review then added two Spec findings and one aggregated test-only fix pass. Therefore the group has two clean successes and two material re-reviews. #113's first implementer harness failure, planner API-529 failures, nested-PTY evidence, and root-remediation Codex attempts all have capabilityFailure:false or are explicitly non-capability integration evidence; they do not establish a required route escalation. #113 reports null usage, cost, token, and duration values, so it is counted in samples but not in the dollar median, which retains three cost-reporting units. The medium final effort is an observed successful recovery step, not a measured medium starting-step cost, so it is not added as a comparable costToAcceptance arm. No two capability-driven units and no 25%-lower stronger-step median exist; no floor raise is allowed. Index 0 cannot be lowered and no lower boundary probe exists. Cost remains confounded by change/context size.
